corrections.why: The refuge describes a 99-foot (about 30.2 m) watch tower at headquarters. The 9.1 m figure (30 ft) matches the 30-foot wood tower at the homestead site, which the Forest Lookouts page lists as removed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Brief lists west_us_lookouts as gone, but the refuge page (current) says the tower is open for climbing and the Montana list and Firelookout.com both show it standing. Treated as standing.
Refuge gives 99 feet; Forest Lookouts gives 100 feet; a Missouri River Country article gives a tower rising 100 feet above the office. Used the refuge figure (99 ft, 30.2 m).
Firelookout.com gives 1930s? with a question mark. Forest Lookouts gives 1936, which fits the March 1935 bid. Used 1936.

notes_for_editor: Brief's source_pages label the Homestead page as a headquarters source; the headquarters page is montanalookouts.weebly.com/medicine-lake-nwr-headquarters.html. No staffing or fire use found; the tower is described as a wildlife observation tower. Elevation not recorded: Firelookout.com says 1975 ft (602 m), the Montana History Portal says 1953 ft (595 m), and the schema has no elevation key. A federal solicitation about rehabilitating the observation tower appeared in search but was not readable (403), so it is not used. The west_us_lookouts 'gone' entry was not read.
